texts.zh:
覆盖[From.GetName]表面的腐朽机器是在惊人的七万年前被建造的。建造它的外星工程师命运如何尚且未知，因为他们已经不住在这颗行星上了。

他们的机器覆盖了行星的大半表面，贯穿山脉，跨越海洋，甚至深入行星地下，遍布于庞杂的地下设施网络中。这一机器由有相同序列号的同种材料建造而成，这表明某一机构独自建造了整个机械网络。从杂草丛生的农业用地，坍塌的发变电系统及广布的通信阵列来看，这台超级机器曾满足了星球上已消逝居民的所有工业和娱乐需求。

引人瞩目的是，这台机器的某些部分仍在运转，发送并接收本地信号，照亮破败的鬼城，浇灌大片曾经一定是农业用地的土地。对行星地壳的深度扫描表明，这台庞大机器的控制中心位于地下：如果我们想要到达它附近，就必须进行挖掘。

至于覆盖着这台行星尺寸级机器的大部分的奇怪的有机组织，我们的科学团队至今仍为它的性质和用途感到困惑。
texts.en:
There is decaying machinery covering [From.GetName], originally constructed a staggering seventy-thousand years ago. The fate of the alien engineers who built it is unclear, as they no longer inhabit the planet.

Their machinery spanned the majority of the surface of the planet, crisscrossing mountains and oceans alike - and even extends far below the planet's surface, in a vast network of underground facilities. It has been constructed using identical materials and serial codes, suggesting a single institution created the entire network. From the long-overgrown agricultural sectors, to the collapsed energy generation and transformation systems and extensive communication arrays, all of the industrial and entertainment needs of this planet's lost inhabitants were met by this one supermachine.

Remarkably, some of these mechanical sectors are still functional: sending and receiving local signals, lighting up long-rotted ghost towns, and watering great swathes of what must have once been agricultural land. Deep scans of the planet's crust suggest the sprawling machine's control center is located underground - we will have to excavate if we wish to reach it.

As for the strange organic tissue covering most of the planet-spanning machinery: our science team thus far remains baffled by its nature and its purpose.
